name: unix-timestamps-wire
prompt: The /session endpoints currently serialize Session with Go's default time.Time JSON shape (RFC3339 with nanoseconds and timezone). Wire clients need stable integer fields: change the JSON representation of Session so Created and LastSeen are emitted as Unix seconds (numbers), without changing the field names (Created, LastSeen) or the in-memory time.Time types. Add the minimum marshaling support needed and make sure the existing endpoints still compile and behave identically apart from the timestamp encoding.
